$comment: Contract FR-016, FR-022, FR-023, FR-025 — the schema transmitted to the analysis endpoint in response_format.json_schema.schema, and the shape re-validated locally on the way back. The enum in `type` is substituted at runtime from the configured vocabulary (FR-026, FR-027); it is shown here with example values. No field names a folder (FR-016). additionalProperties is false and every property is required, because OpenAI-compatible strict mode demands both — optional fields are expressed as a nullable type, not by omission from `required`.
name: document_metadata

title.description: A short human-readable title for the document, in the document's own language.

type.description: The kind of document. Choose the single closest value. If none clearly applies, choose the fallback value.

correspondent.description: The organisation or person the document is from. Null if not determinable.

tags.description: Lowercase keywords describing the document's subject. Never a folder or a path.

document_date.description: The date the document itself bears, as YYYY-MM-DD. Null if the document bears no date. Never today's date.

due_date.description: A payment or response deadline, as YYYY-MM-DD. Null if none.

reference.description: An invoice number, contract reference, or customer number. Null if none.

description.description: One sentence on what the document is about. Null if not determinable.

amount.description: The principal monetary amount as a decimal string, e.g. "1234.56". Null if the document states none. Must be accompanied by currency.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code for the amount, e.g. "EUR". Null if the document states no amount.

filename.description: A proposed base filename describing the document, without extension, without any date prefix, and without any path separator. Lowercase words joined by hyphens.
